say:1:1510321001:0.text: My spear, bestowed upon me by Sarethiel, the God of Harvest. No one has ever faced its edge unscathed...
say:1:1510321001:0.source_cn: 我手中的武器，乃是丰饶神赛图恩亲授之枪。正面接下我的攻...
say:1:1510321001:0.male: My spear, bestowed upon me by Sarethiel, the God of Harvest. No one has ever faced its edge unscathed...
say:1:1510321001:0.female: My spear, bestowed upon me by Sarethiel, the God of Harvest. No one has ever faced its edge unscathed...

say:4:1510321003:0.text: To curry your favor, the Wildborn fashioned a ghastly garland... Eighty-three heads of my finest warriors, offered upon your altar. That was merely the beginning...
say:4:1510321003:0.source_cn: 为了取悦你，兽人们曾把我麾下八十三名士兵的头颅串成项链...
say:4:1510321003:0.male: To curry your favor, the Wildborn fashioned a ghastly garland... Eighty-three heads of my finest warriors, offered upon your altar. That was merely the beginning...
say:4:1510321003:0.female: To curry your favor, the Wildborn fashioned a ghastly garland... Eighty-three heads of my finest warriors, offered upon your altar. That was merely the beginning...

say:5:1510321004:0.text: But saying this is pointless now...
say:5:1510321004:0.source_cn: 事到如今，说这些也无济于事。
say:5:1510321004:0.male: But saying this is pointless now...
say:5:1510321004:0.female: But saying this is pointless now...

say:7:1510321007:0.text: Perseus, I brought your men back to you as agreed, and secured an opportunity for the Halians and the Wildborn to negotiate for peace.
say:7:1510321007:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯，我依照约定为你带回部下，并且争取到了雅库伯尔...

say:8:1510321008:0.text: If you want to repay me, have that gaping wound on your neck looked at. I don't fancy bloody offerings.
say:8:1510321008:0.source_cn: 你想要报答，也不必端着自己颈上碗口大的伤疤向我敬来鲜血。

say:9:1510321009:0.text: Are you laughing at me again, Lady Merlin?
say:9:1510321009:0.source_cn: 梅林女士，你这是在嘲笑我？

say:10:1510321010:0.text: I'm not laughing at you. I'm just surprised at your reckless behavior.
say:10:1510321010:0.source_cn: 不是嘲笑，只是惊讶于你今日的鲁莽举动。

say:11:1510321011:0.text: Count your blessings that the Hunting God isn't as cruel as you think. Otherwise, your head would've rolled.
say:11:1510321011:0.source_cn: 你该庆幸，庆幸狩猎神并非你想象的那般残忍，否则你早已身...
say:11:1510321011:0.male: Count your blessings that the Hunting God isn't as cruel as you think. Otherwise, your head would've rolled.
say:11:1510321011:0.female: Count your blessings that the Hunting Goddess isn't as cruel as you think. Otherwise, your head would've rolled.

say:12:1510321012:0.text: If the god of your foes walked before you, would you not think that fate was offering you a chance you shouldn't ignore?
say:12:1510321012:0.source_cn: 敌人信奉的神明大摇大摆来到我面前，我不会错过这么好的刺...
say:12:1510321012:0.male: If the god of your foes walked before you, would you not think that fate was offering you a chance you shouldn't ignore?
say:12:1510321012:0.female: If the god of your foes walked before you, would you not think that fate was offering you a chance you shouldn't ignore?

say:13:1510321013:0.text: Thank you for your... clarity. I often worry I don't understand you well enough. I hope you keep sharing these... wonderful thoughts with me.
say:13:1510321013:0.source_cn: 感谢说明。我时常苦恼于不够了解你，希望你以后也愿意多和...

say:14:1510321014:0.text: If you really want to talk, let's talk somewhere else, and I'm only talking to you, Lady Merlin.
say:14:1510321014:0.source_cn: 如果你真的想谈，换个地方说吧。我只和你谈，梅林女士。

narration:16:1510321015:0.text: Perseus turns and gestures to the tense soldiers around him.
narration:16:1510321015:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯转身离去，他对周围剑拔弩张的士兵做了个手势

narration:17:1510321016:0.text: All the soldiers put their weapons away at his signal.
narration:17:1510321016:0.source_cn: 士兵们得到指令后，纷纷收起了武器

say:18:1510321017:0.text: Honestly, thinking you can kill a god all by yourself? I thought only Morgan would say something that stupid.
say:18:1510321017:0.source_cn: 嗯……想以一己之力弑神这种傻话，我还以为只有摩根说得出来。
say:18:1510321017:0.male: Honestly, thinking you can kill a god all by yourself? I thought only Morgan would say something that stupid.
say:18:1510321017:0.female: Honestly, thinking you can kill a goddess all by yourself? I thought only Morgan would say something that stupid.

say:19:1510321018:0.text: Herdmaster, forgive Perseus for what he just did. He told his men to lower their weapons. That means he doesn't think you'll attack. Everything is going as well as we hoped.
say:19:1510321018:0.source_cn: 神啊，请宽恕珀尔修斯方才的行径，他已经令士兵们放下武器...
say:19:1510321018:0.male: Herdmaster, forgive Perseus for what he just did. He told his men to lower their weapons. That means he doesn't think you'll attack. Everything is going as well as we hoped.
say:19:1510321018:0.female: Herdmaster, forgive Perseus for what he just did. He told his men to lower their weapons. That means he doesn't think you'll attack. Everything is going as well as we hoped.

choice_prompt:20:1510321018.female: Herdmaster, forgive Perseus for what he just did. He told his men to lower their weapons. That means he doesn't think you'll attack. Everything is going as well as we hoped.

say:21:1510321019:0.text: Your mercy leaves me in awe.
say:21:1510321019:0.source_cn: 您的仁慈令我五体投地。
say:21:1510321019:0.male: Your mercy leaves me in awe.
say:21:1510321019:0.female: Your mercy leaves me in awe.

say:23:1510321022:0.text: Your little emissary needs calming as well. She looks like she wants to rip his eyes out.
say:23:1510321022:0.source_cn: 我也是想对您的小神使解释一下，看她的眼神，似乎恨不得把...
say:23:1510321022:0.male: Your little emissary needs calming as well. She looks like she wants to rip his eyes out.
say:23:1510321022:0.female: Your little emissary needs calming as well. She looks like she wants to rip his eyes out.

say:24:1510321023:0.text: He was disrespectful to the Hunting God.
say:24:1510321023:0.male: He was disrespectful to the Hunting God.
say:24:1510321023:0.female: He was disrespectful to the Hunting Goddess.

say:25:1510321024:0.text: I am grateful to you also.
say:25:1510321024:0.source_cn: 所以我也对你表示感激。

say:27:1510321026:0.text: I appreciate you didn't go for his jugular.
say:27:1510321026:0.source_cn: 感激你刚才没有扑上去咬他的脖颈。

say:28:1510321027:0.text: This is not a funny joke.

say:29:1510321028:0.text: I don't ask you to laugh. Just do me a favor and don't sink your teeth into anyone's neck until I return.
say:29:1510321028:0.source_cn: 我不请求你笑，只请求你在我回来前别去咬其他呼临人的脖颈。

say:30:1510321029:0.text: As long as they don't harm the Hunting God...
say:30:1510321029:0.source_cn: ……只要他们不伤害狩猎神大人。
say:30:1510321029:0.male: As long as they don't harm the Hunting God...
say:30:1510321029:0.female: As long as they don't harm the Hunting Goddess...

say:31:1510321030:0.text: Trust me, they won't. Or... perhaps they lack the nerve. Few warriors are as bold as Perseus.
say:31:1510321030:0.source_cn: 我向你保证，他们不会的。或者说……他们不敢。不是每一位...

say:32:1510321031:0.text: If you excuse me for a moment, I'll go have a word with our wayward general, and return shortly.
say:32:1510321031:0.source_cn: 那么，请二位在此稍后片刻了，我去和珀尔修斯聊聊，很快回来。

say:34:1510321020:0.source_cn: 您的强大我等有目共睹。

say:35:1510321021:0.text: I don't expect you to forgive, but please be patient.
say:35:1510321021:0.source_cn: 好吧，我不奢求您宽恕原谅。
say:35:1510321021:0.male: I don't expect you to forgive, but please be patient.
say:35:1510321021:0.female: I don't expect you to forgive, but please be patient.

choice:20:2:3.text: I'll have my revenge one day.
choice:20:2:3.male: I'll have my revenge one day.
choice:20:2:3.female: I'll have my revenge one day.

say:36:1510321005:0.text: As a warrior, how can I be afraid of death?
say:36:1510321005:0.male: As a warrior, how can I be afraid of death?
say:36:1510321005:0.female: As a warrior, how can I be afraid of death?

say:37:1510321006:0.text: As long as Halia has a future, my life does not matter.
say:37:1510321006:0.source_cn: 只要呼临能有未来，我不是非得活。
say:37:1510321006:0.male: As long as Halia has a future, my life does not matter.
say:37:1510321006:0.female: As long as Halia has a future, my life does not matter.

choice:3:1:2.text: Are you not afraid of death?
choice:3:1:2.male: Are you not afraid of death?
